perturbation: Rotate cluster rows by one and raise claim to the cap for a fixed evenly spaced subset. Strong includes both moderate identities. This validates proposal stress, with a shared coordinator and logical model-neighbor topology.
split: Grouped by structural WL fingerprint, whole groups allocated to approximately 60/20/20 train/audit/test. Three separately seeded partitions of each dataset. Training labels used only to allocate train clients, test labels accessed by scoring after prediction seal.
features: Train-fitted depth-2, 512-bin WL-TFIDF, L2 normalized. Temperature 0.25. Local k-means++ then 12 initial Lloyd steps, Hungarian cluster alignment, 0.20 neighbor mixing, one local step per communication round (step size 0.25, no more than 32 train graphs sampled without replacement). Every seventh opportunity for each client resends its old version by a fixed staggered schedule.
probe_law: Independent seeded uniform IID design/audit draws with replacement from the same finite audit role, shared across paired policies. Exact audit also evaluates every graph in that same finite role; outer test serves downstream endpoints.
timing: Identical cached graph outputs for screened and full composition search, untimed warmups, alternating order with seeded first arm. Pipeline elapsed is single Windows CPU process plus TCP loopback, excluding offline reference evaluation, outer inference and export.
transport: Every logical client sends a float64 prototype and claim to one coordinator and receives a status, two-byte mask and state hash over a single local TCP connection. Application payload bytes counted after receive. Logical topology changes proposal mixing, not transport links.

recovery.metric: Outer test mean total variation versus matching clean arm run, 0.5 times L1 over probabilities
recovery.confirmation: first three consecutive rounds <= threshold in rounds 36-60, confirmation is final round of streak

quality: Sealed independent outer predictions, NMI and ARI primary, paired endpoint difference in percentage points, report all outer splits, repeated partitions nested in split. No equivalence claim.
hardware: Local CPU/TCP only. Jetson device fields require four-node measurement.
